jei.orefishfarm.info.fish_tank: A fish eats fish food and sheds its product. Tanks of the same habitat placed together join into one aquarium, up to 8x8x8. Kits change a tank: a Heating Coil or Void Lens changes its habitat (a water bucket changes it back), a Dynamo Coil makes it a power tank. With Breeding switched on, each fish has a breeding timer (about 3 minutes of eating) that starts when it goes in. When it runs out, the fish picks a random partner it can breed with and tries for a baby; a baby needs a free fish slot. Fish breed with their own species, with related fish, and with any fish a recipe on the Breeding page pairs them with. A baby is one of its parents' species. A gene both parents carry always passes on; otherwise each passes half the time from a parent of the baby's own species and a quarter of the time from the other; a baby that inherits every trait a recipe lists becomes that recipe's fish. How likely the baby is to be born depends on what it is: same species 50%, two species 30% (and 3 levels lower), a recipe fish 10%.
jei.orefishfarm.info.dynamo_coil: Use on a Fish Tank to make the aquarium a power tank: power fish make FE while they eat. Sneak-use with an empty hand to take the coil back.
jei.orefishfarm.info.habitat_food: Fish food for one habitat. While it is being eaten, every fish in a tank of that habitat lives, wherever it comes from, so fish from different habitats can share a tank and breed. A tank eats it first when a visiting fish needs it.
jei.orefishfarm.info.fish_bone: Left by a fish that died outside its habitat. Crafts into bone meal.
item.orefishfarm.lava_rod.desc: Fishes in lava as well as water. Fireproof
item.orefishfarm.void_rod.desc: Cast off an edge over the open void (in the End) to fish the void
jei.orefishfarm.info.lava_rod: A rod that fishes lava as well as water. What it catches depends only on the liquid. Any rod in the #orefishfarm:lava_rods tag can do this.
jei.orefishfarm.info.void_rod: Cast off an edge where nothing is below, all the way down (the End, or any dimension in #orefishfarm:void_fishing). The bobber settles a few blocks down and fishes the void. Any rod in #orefishfarm:void_rods can do this.
message.orefishfarm.tank_full: No free fish slot in this aquarium
message.orefishfarm.needs_live_fish: Only live fish go in a tank: a fish in a bucket
jei.orefishfarm.info.fish_bucket: A live fish. Fish Tanks hold buckets of fish: use one on a tank, or put it in a fish slot. Catch fish alive by fishing with their habitat's bucket in your inventory (a water bucket for water fish, a Void Bucket for void fish), or scoop a wild one with a water bucket. Any mob bucket works in a tank, from vanilla or other mods; squid and glow squid can be bucketed with a water bucket too. A newborn stays in its tank (marked * until you look at it) until you scoop it out: click it holding its habitat's bucket (water bucket, lava bucket or Void Bucket). A fish's stats and genes show once it is in a bucket.
tooltip.orefishfarm.newborn: Newborn: scoop it out with its habitat's bucket

message.orefishfarm.tackle_replaced: Your %s broke; clipped on a spare
jei.orefishfarm.info.void_bucket: The void, in a bucket. Aim an empty bucket steeply down into the void, with nothing below you all the way to the bottom of the world, and it fills. Placed, void liquid spreads 2 blocks and hurts like the void itself; scoop it back up with an empty bucket. Void fish are caught alive and scooped out of tanks with a Void Bucket, and it turns a tank into a void tank.

item.orefishfarm.barkacuda.desc: Scaled in tree bark. Sheds bark scales of all kinds of trees
